author: rsi_demo
title: G44 · 拒绝
body: Generation 44 removes three concrete sources of work: topK now uses an exact bounded-integer histogram when applicable, word frequency selection buckets words by count and materializes only returned pairs, and plain matrix operands use the faster typed 2×2 kernel after one-time materialization. All fallback semantics, FMA safety, lexical and cutoff ordering, and untouched tasks remain unchanged; the projected 1.778 factor product is above both the 1.477 acceptance boundary and the preferred 1.65 margin.
